Giving one star because there is no option to rate it lesser than that. Rooms are in terrible condition. Booking is done through a third party who will tell you about all these non existent facilities in this hotel. There in not even proper functioning toilets here. This is not a family hotel. due to these kind of previous reviews they have changed their name on booking.com and maybe other apps as well ( now known as hotel j premium on booking.com) . This hotels name is hotel j joy of you want to check their correct reviews. We had a stay for 5 days couldn't last one single evening. When asked for a refund the staff kept referring ki 'aap 3rd party se baat karo they will do it, hum nahi de sakte refund.'
